description: R08 Host ScreenBuffer VT-resize checkpoint: safe Rust owns CSI 8 t viewport/buffer-width coordination, comprehensive resize vectors, DECCOLM gating/reset side effects, and preservation of extended current attributes across both resize paths.

entries.notes: VtResizeState applies CSI 8 t by retaining physical buffer height, resizing the safe buffer width and viewport to Microsoft's four concrete vectors, and treating 8;0;0t as an exact no-op.

The direct witness executes all 25 Microsoft dx/dy combinations around the 80x25 viewport and verifies exact requested viewport dimensions with matching buffer width and unchanged physical buffer height.

DECCOLM is inert until DECSET 40 enables column switching; enabled set/reset select 132/80 columns, preserve heights, clear vertical margins and home the relative cursor, while disabling DECSET 40 restores no-op behavior.
Both CSI 8 t and enabled DECCOLM round-trip 80/132-column widths without mutating the active RGB foreground/background/underline color, crossed-out, curly-underline or italic attributes.
